depends_on: Wright 2013, Bull. London Math. Soc. 45, 943-952 (Carmichael numbers in coprime progressions; not formalized)
COM-C127 and COM-C128 write-ups (Larsen 2025) for parts 2-3
notes: Part 1 (= C126) false: P066_part1 (P066_mathlib.lean): for every P = a mod M (gcd(a,M) = 1, M = 4*3*5*13*313*17*11489*31*7*601*390001*19*829*5167) and every m, n with 6^n | P+5^m, (P+5^m)/6^n is not a prime power: P = 1 mod 4 forces n <= 1; n = 0 gives 2*odd; n = 1 forces m odd and two disjoint coverings of odd m (mod 16 and mod 144) give two distinct primes. Wright 2013 gives infinitely many Carmichael (hence Poulet) P in this coprime class. Parts 2, 3 false by the C127, C128 write-ups; part 4 ill-posed (exceptions undefined). Outside Lean: Wright's theorem (and Larsen's for parts 2-3).
